propositions: The epic-close bug screen converts LLM provider errors (e.g. Bedrock ValidationException) into per-candidate 'unrelated' verdicts via broad exception handling, silently blinding the caused_by bug floor when systematic outages occur.
max_tokens is never re-clamped when the resolved model has a smaller ceiling than the configured value, causing provider rejections (400 Bad Request) on Bedrock but not Anthropic.

The completion verifier must propagate LLMUnavailableError (including subclass LLMConfigError) from both warm calls and fan-out worker threads instead of degrading to verdict C, to fail the close gate closed and block the ticket transition.
Non-provider per-candidate failures (malformed output, store read glitches) must continue to degrade open to maintain documented screen behavior for transient, non-systemic failures.
The --force-close escape hatch must remain available to allow operator override of a provider-error-blocked close without changing gate semantics.
